entities.summary: The Institute of Plant Industry, Vavilov Institute of Plant Industry or N. I. Vavilov All-Russian Institute of Plant Genetic Resources (VIR), as it is officially called since 2015, is a research institute of plant genetics and seed bank, located in Saint Petersburg, Russia.
